3.151 Link time configuration
Definition
The configuration of the SW module is done during link time.
Initiator
WP ECU Configuration
Further
Explanations
The object code of the SW modules receives parts of its configuration from
another object code file or it is defined by linker options.
Comment
--
Example
Initial value of a signal.
Reference
--
